item: The file-lock interrupt tests no longer probe the lock while their helper thread still holds it
summary: test_an_interrupt_in_the_hold_statistic_after_the_section_leaves_nothing_held failed on #1858's shard 3 (head da44ece86) with BlockingIOError Errno 11 on its final LOCK_NB probe of the operating-system lock. Its helper _another_thread_takes_it (R176, 4f91cc06c) returned when its thread called got.set(), which is still inside with lock(target), so the probe on the next line raced the helper's release; a loaded runner sometimes lost. The export lane reproduced it by holding that release 0.3 s through a pytest plugin, and so did this lane (main: 1 failed, Errno 11). The helper now joins its thread before returning and fails when the thread has not let the lock go within 10 s, so the probe runs on a released lock; what both callers assert is unchanged. With the 0.3 s hold all 34 tests in the file pass, and without it too. Release-notes line (R319): internal, users see no change.
